patterns.message: db sits below api and ui (PLAN.md dependency direction: db → domain only). Move this composition up to packages/api.
db is server-side data access — no UI frameworks (PLAN.md dependency direction). Rendering belongs in packages/ui or apps/web.
the tRPC layer lives in packages/api, which consumes db — never the reverse (PLAN.md dependency direction). Move routers and validation to packages/api.
auth wiring lives in packages/api (PLAN.md dependency direction). Keep db to plain tables and repositories; api owns better-auth.
